newsitem.title: USA: Metatec sees q2 eps meet expectations.
newsitem.headline: Metatec sees q2 eps meet expectations.

text.p: Metatec Corp said on Friday it expected earnings for the second quarter ending June 30 to meet analysts' expectations of $0.04 to $0.05 per share.
Metatec also said it would continue its share repurchase program, which authorizes buybacks of up to 700,000 shares through December 31.
The company has bought back 200,000 shares since its board of directors authorized the program in November 1996.
Metatec reported a net loss of $0.03 per share in the first quarter, compared with a $0.15 profit the year before. The company's shares closed at 3-1/8 on Friday, up 5/16.
